purpose: Research-introduced requirements applied equally to candidate construction but excluded from the V2 policy-preservation oracle because they are not derived from V2.

visibility.candidate_construction: May be expressed through the common TASK/CANDIDATE construction contract.

invariants.name: Decision control protocol
invariants.normalized_policy: Classify decisions as Decided, Delegated, or Reserved; Reserved changes require explicit approval and headless runs must not silently alter architecture.

invariants.name: Challenge questionable instructions
invariants.normalized_policy: Before implementing a questionable request, identify concrete concerns such as duplication, cohesion, triggering, context, conflicts, or complexity and propose an alternative.
